nodes.description: Library function performing checked addition a + b, reverting with default message 'add: +' on overflow.
Library function performing checked addition a + b, reverting with a caller-supplied error message on overflow.
Library function delegating to sub(uint,uint,string) with default message 'sub: -' to prevent underflow.
Library function performing checked subtraction a - b after require(b <= a), reverting with a caller-supplied message on underflow.
Library function performing checked multiplication a * b with early return on zero and require(c / a == b), message 'mul: *'.
Library function performing checked multiplication a * b with early return on zero and require(c / a == b) using a caller-supplied message.
Library function delegating to div(uint,uint,string) with default message 'div: /' to prevent division by zero.
Library function performing integer division a / b after require(b > 0), reverting with a caller-supplied message on division by zero.

Public constant state variable holding IChainLinkFeed at address 0x169E633A2D1E6c10dD91238Ba11c4A708dfEF37C; external oracle dependency read by getQuoteLimit.
External view function of KperNetworkHelper that returns gasUsed multiplied by the live oracle answer from FASTGAS.latestAnswer().
External interface function on the ChainLink feed returning an int256 price; return value is cast to uint and used as a multiplier.
Raw addition a + b executed before the overflow require; guarded by SafeMath checks in add(uint,uint) and add(uint,uint,string).
Raw multiplication a * b executed before the overflow require; guarded by SafeMath checks in mul(uint,uint) and mul(uint,uint,string).
Raw subtraction a - b executed after require(b <= a); guarded against underflow in sub(uint,uint,string).
Raw integer division a / b executed after require(b > 0); guarded against division by zero.
Raw modulo a % b executed after require(b != 0); guarded against zero divisor.
External call to FASTGAS.latestAnswer() inside getQuoteLimit; unchecked oracle return value used directly in an unchecked-context arithmetic expression.
Parameter gasUsed of getQuoteLimit(uint gasUsed), supplied by the external caller and used as the multiplication operand.

edges.reason: Caller-supplied parameter gasUsed flows into the body of getQuoteLimit as the value to be scaled.
getQuoteLimit reads the constant state variable FASTGAS to reach the price feed contract.
getQuoteLimit depends on an external oracle (ChainLink latestAnswer) whose returned price is trusted without any validation or staleness check.
Return value of IChainLinkFeed.latestAnswer() flows into the external-call operation and is cast to uint for arithmetic.
getQuoteLimit performs the external call to FASTGAS.latestAnswer() during evaluation of the return expression.
getQuoteLimit invokes SafeMath.mul via gasUsed.mul(...), routing the computation through the checked multiplication.
gasUsed and the oracle answer are the operands of the multiplication a * b inside SafeMath.mul.
SafeMath.mul(uint,uint) executes the raw multiplication a * b before its overflow require.
SafeMath.mul(uint,uint,string) executes the raw multiplication a * b before its overflow require.
SafeMath.add(uint,uint) executes the raw addition a + b guarded by require(c >= a).
SafeMath.add(uint,uint,string) executes the raw addition a + b guarded by require(c >= a, errorMessage).
SafeMath.sub(uint,uint) reaches the subtraction through delegation to sub(uint,uint,string).
SafeMath.sub(uint,uint,string) executes the raw subtraction a - b after require(b <= a).
SafeMath.div(uint,uint) reaches the division through delegation to div(uint,uint,string).
SafeMath.div(uint,uint,string) executes the raw division a / b after require(b > 0).
SafeMath.mod(uint,uint) reaches the modulo through delegation to mod(uint,uint,string).
SafeMath.mod(uint,uint,string) executes the raw modulo a % b after require(b != 0).
sub(uint,uint) delegates to the message-carrying overload sub(uint,uint,string).
div(uint,uint) delegates to the message-carrying overload div(uint,uint,string).
mod(uint,uint) delegates to the message-carrying overload mod(uint,uint,string).
